scrape-parity.name: caddy
scrape-parity.reason: the ingress runs only in prod; nothing locally serves a Caddy admin endpoint to scrape

scrape-parity.name: sity-web
scrape-parity.reason: sity has an ingress route, an ECR repository and a deploy role, but no deploy workflow and no production compose in the sity repo, so nothing ever runs sity-web in prod. A prod job would scrape an address that does not exist and ServiceDown would page forever. Remove this entry in the same change that adds sity's own deploy workflow.

scrape-parity.name: trading-bot-operator-console
scrape-parity.reason: trading-bot has an ingress route, an ECR repository and a manual-dispatch deploy, but nothing runs it: its seven containers need ~10.6 GiB and the host has 8. A prod job would scrape an address that does not exist and ServiceDown would fire forever. Remove the five trading-bot entries together once the host is large enough to run it.
